evidence: Adds CI workflow, Dockerfiles, and scripts for Guix builds under .github/workflows/guix.yml, ci/, and contrib/guix/.
rationale: Automating Guix release builds and codesigning checks in CI significantly protects release integrity by detecting toolchain and manifest breakage before release time. As noted in the description, 'our entire custom-built static glibc and compiler toolchain would be relatively untested by current CI jobs' without this continuous verification.
